contract_audit.author: Codex s-pck-2c-host
contract_audit.authorization: Deputy S approved G-A concrete selection, G-B one-pass F/PLEN outputs plus torn-tail overwrite at committed PLEN, G-C concrete frame writer, and G-D guard verification. Every new keystone statement goes in this item before its persvati REPL proof. The prior four gaps are authorized implementation work, not permission barriers. G-C explicitly requires STOP if the arena has no length invariant implying 1+LEN < 2^64.
contract_audit.stop: G-C's conditional stop is met. fn-arena-p-is-payload-listp (books/payload-arena.lisp:569) equates the arena recognizer with fn-arn-payload-listp. That recognizer (books/payload-arena-bytes.lisp:47) checks octet lists only; it has no length conjunct. fn-arn-extent-guardp (books/payload-arena-extent-logic.lisp:35) requires natural descriptor fields and containment only. fn-arena$x-seal-extent (books/payload-arena-extent.lisp:717) uses precisely that descriptor guard plus the existing arena invariant. fn-arx-extentp-plen (:1182) concludes only natp. Neither the abstract arena nor the extent admission guard establishes the frame bound.
contract_audit.counterexample: At the descriptor guard, set FILE=EOFF=POFF=TRAILER=0 and ELEN=PLEN=18446744073709551615 (2^64-1). All natural and containment conjuncts of fn-arn-extent-guardp hold, but (< (+ 1 PLEN) 18446744073709551616) is false. This is direct reduction of the guard, not a failed proof search, not a claim about a reachable served record, and does not require allocating the denoted payload. fn-cpl-payloadp (books/checkpoint-payload-ref.lisp:98) requires that strict inequality. The length implication requested of the arena invariant is therefore unavailable.
contract_audit.recommendation_for_S: Retain the unbounded generic arena. Audit a replacement G-C premise derived from the supported admission/profile and persisted-record path, with a named preservation theorem establishing frame-fit for every delta row at the capture. That premise must actually be carried/discharged at the host caller; adding it to the writer alone would not close the seam. If the served path does not establish it, an ACL2 publication refusal policy needs an explicit contract. No such replacement has been assumed or implemented here.
contract_audit.scope: Stopped before proofs or host changes as instructed. G-A/G-B/G-D GO remains in force for resumption after the G-C bound contract is settled. No new keystone, no theorem weakening, no arena ceiling, no rerun of unrelated gates, no certify job, no push. Premise-audit delta is empty because proof and host source are unchanged.

approved_layers.G-A-statement:
(defthm fn-pck-x-open-selection-is-the-selection
 (implies (and (equal verdict (if (not filep) :absent (if (equal (car (pgs-open disk r mode)) :ok) :ok :corrupt)))
               (implies (equal verdict :ok) (equal s (len (fn-sco-records (fn-pck-capture-of-pages (second (pgs-view (pgs-open disk r mode))) file)))))
               (equal start (if (consp log) (car log) nil)))
          (equal (fn-pck-x-open-selection verdict s count k start)
                 (fn-pck-open-selection filep disk r mode file count k log))))
approved_layers.G-A-scope: The S equation is the decoded capture count supplied by resident-open correspondence. No model DISK or FILE argument to the executable. Verdict is :absent/:ok/:corrupt. A malformed retained start also refuses adoption. Guard T; comparisons belong to ACL2. Teeth: ground successful model open with all antecedents and conclusion; start>S must refuse; must-fail assertion of adoption for that same ground case.
approved_layers.G-B-statement:
(defthm fn-pck-x-open-summary-is-the-root
 (implies (and (fn-pck-recordsp configs recs) (fn-pck-root-fitsp configs recs)
               (equal npg (len (fn-pck-pages configs recs)))
               (equal (pgs-x-words 0 0 (* 2048 npg) pgs-mem) (adt-tp-flat (fn-pck-pages configs recs)))
               (<= (* 2048 npg) (pgs-x-len 0 pgs-mem)) (natp fid))
  (let ((r (fn-pck-x-open npg pgs-mem fid fn-arena fn-octets))
        (root (fn-pck-root-tree-of-capture (fn-sco-capture configs recs)
                                         (fn-pck-f configs recs) (fn-pck-plen recs 0))))
   (and (equal (mv-nth 6 r) (nth 4 root)) (equal (mv-nth 7 r) (nth 5 root))))))
approved_layers.G-B-layout: Append F and PLEN at result positions 6 and 7; preserve existing result slots 0..5 and the capture keystone conclusion verbatim. No second decoder or payload read. The root-summary theorem needs only the resident image and valid encoded history, not durable payload contents, since it reads the root. G-B torn-tail write theorem and tooth follow in payload layer; base will be committed PLEN, never EOF.
